name: @project-sakura/pay-spec
description: The shared spec, test vectors and contract scenarios behind every Sakura Pay SDK.

scripts.check:py: cd ../sdk-python && uv run --frozen ruff check src tests && uv run --frozen ruff format --check src tests && uv run --frozen mypy && uv run --frozen pytest -q && uv build -q
scripts.check: npm run check:spec && npm run check:ts && npm run check:py
scripts.test:contract: npm run test:contract:ts && npm run test:contract:py
